name: cna-ts
description: Canonical TypeScript and JavaScript binding for CNA with an XNA 4.0 API projection

scripts.test:native: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/native-cna.integration.mjs
scripts.test:content: npm run build && npm run build:content && node --test content/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:content:required: npm run build && npm run build:content && CNA_REQUIRE_CONTENT_TESTS=1 node --test content/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:model-part: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/native-model-part.integration.mjs
scripts.test:content-survey: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/content-survey.integration.mjs
scripts.test:input-devices: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/input-devices.integration.mjs
scripts.test:media-library: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/media-library.integration.mjs
scripts.test:avatars: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/avatar-description.integration.mjs
scripts.test:sprite-font-oracle: npm run build:native-bridge && npm run build && node --test test/sprite-font-oracle.integration.mjs
scripts.test:effect-reflection:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_EFFECT_TESTS=1 node --test test/effect-reflection.integration.mjs
scripts.test:windowed:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_WINDOWED_TESTS=1 node --test test/windowed-renderer.integration.mjs
scripts.test:wasm-browser:non-engine:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_NON_ENGINE_WASM_TESTS=1 node --test test/wasm-browser-non-engine.mjs
scripts.test:wasm-browser:strong:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_STRONG_WASM_TESTS=1 node --test test/wasm-browser-strong.mjs
scripts.test:wasm-browser:audio:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_AUDIO_WASM_TESTS=1 node --test test/wasm-browser-audio.mjs
scripts.test:wasm-browser:audio-capture:required: npm run build && CNA_REQUIRE_AUDIO_CAPTURE_TESTS=1 node --test test/wasm-browser-audio-capture.mjs
scripts.report:cna-abi: node tools/audit-cna-abi.mjs --portable --format json --output docs/cna-abi-report.json && node tools/cna-abi/verify-contract.mjs --portable --format json --output docs/cna-abi-contract-report.json && node tools/api-compat/verify-runtime.mjs --format json --output docs/runtime-symbol-report.json && node tools/api-compat/verify.mjs --leak-only --format json --output docs/internal-leak-report.json
scripts.verify:wasm: node tools/wasm/sync-routes.mjs --check && node tools/wasm/verify-route-calls.mjs && node tools/wasm/verify-struct-fields.mjs && node tools/mutation-plans/check-anchors.mjs && node tools/wasm/verify-oracles.mjs && node tools/wasm/backend-gap.mjs --check
